Arrow (Biotoxin).name: Flecha (Biotoxina)
Arrow (Biotoxin).description:
No immediate damage. Does not ablate armor. On a hit, the target rolls a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV15 Resist Torture/Drugs}. On a failure, the target takes [[/r 3d6dmg#Biotoxin Damage]]{3d6 Damage} directly.

Does not affect inorganic targets.

Arrow (Expansive).name: Flecha (Expansiva)
Arrow (Expansive).description:
If the victim rolls the Foreign object Critical Injury (see pg. 187), they also roll for a second (different) Critical Injury.

The second Critical Injury does not deal bonus damage.

Arrow (Incendiary).name: Flecha (incendiaria)
Arrow (Incendiary).description:
If damage dealt to target they are set On Fire (Mild). Target takes 2 damage to HP at end of their turn unless they use action to extinguish flames.

Fire effects do not stack.

Arrow (Poison).name: Flecha (veneno)
Arrow (Poison).description:
No immediate damage. On a hit, the target rolls a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs}. On a failure, the target takes [[/r 3d6dmg#Poison Damage]]{2d6 Damage} directly.

Does not affect inorganic targets.

Arrow (Rubber).name: Flecha (Goma)
Arrow (Rubber).description:
Does not cause Critical Injury. Does not ablate armor. Leaves target at minimum 1hp. Counts as Basic ammo for exotic weapons.

Non-lethal damage not currently supported by system.

Arrow (Sleep).name: Flecha (Dormir)
Arrow (Sleep).description:
Deals no damage. Target rolls a [[/r 1d10red+@stats.will+@skills.resistTortureOrDrugs #DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs]]{DV13 Resist Torture/Drugs}. On a failure, the target falls Prone (see pg. 169) and unconscious for 1 minute. Can be woken by damage or another person using an action to touch/shake them.

Does not affect inorganic targets.

Arrow (Smart).name: Flecha (Inteligente)
Arrow (Smart).description:
If you miss a single shot attack by 4 or less, make a [[/r 1d10red+10 #Smart Ammo Attack]]{Smart Ammo} attack roll. Your target can still attempt to dodge the second roll as normal.

Requires @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.wFp72x2FXhipZXPj]{Targeting Scope Cyberware} - Not enforced by system.
